version: v14.1 (2026-10-21): per-region year, training-site distance split

inputs.our_map: data/processed/v5/maps/<Region>/pred_<year>.csv.gz (column r1; model fitted to all labels, TDD to 1 September); mean_2011_2024.csv.gz (aoa_in)
inputs.product_values_at_labels: data/processed/v5/products_cell_year_v5.csv (product wei / liu, year of the figure)

why_this_year: per region, the year with the most observed 1 km cells with a value in our map, Wei 2026 and Liu 2024 (Liu 2024 ends in 2020); Alaska 2013 (126 common cells; next 2018 and 2014), Lena Delta 2016 (14; next 2014), Canada 2013 (33; other years at most 12)

definition.colour_range: per region: 5th-95th percentile of the pooled display pixels of our map, Wei 2026 and Liu 2024 inside our area of applicability, rounded outwards to 5 cm; values beyond are drawn at the end colours
definition.product_mask: product pixels are drawn only where our map has a value (same area in the three maps)
definition.observed_cells: common cells (our map, Wei 2026 and Liu 2024 all have a value) drawn as filled circles coloured by the observed ALT on the same scale
definition.scatter: observed cell mean against the prediction of each series at the common cells; our series = block-CV out-of-fold predictions (seeds averaged per label, then cell mean), not the in-sample map; r = Pearson correlation; RMSE over the common cells; markers filled = cell within 25 km of a Wei 2026 training site, open = beyond; the panel prints the RMSE for all cells and for the open cells

product_training_sites.note: distances are to the nearest Wei 2026 training site (the 25 km mask of Fig. 5a); scatter markers: filled = within, open = beyond
product_training_sites.distance_source: data/processed/xbatch/XG_product_comparison/xg_leak_cells_v1.csv (product == 'wei', nearest Wei 2026 training site per label; cell value = minimum over its labels)

band_differences.definition: mean (product − our map) over the 1 km map cells of the latitude band with a value in both, split at 600 m elevation (grid dem_elev); product cell value = mean of its display pixels
